title: Deduplicate hand-rolled e2e fakes (_FakeContentRepository, _NullTutoredSelection) before more copies drift like learning_p1_test.dart's broken filterByLevel
area: test/e2e/journeys (learning_p0/p1, hebrew_rtl_p1, learning_sched_gam_p2, + 7 more files outside this batch)

evidence.quote: if (level1 != null) items = items.where((i) => i.level1 == level1).toList();

why: Every journey file that needs a no-op tutored-selection notifier or a fake ContentRepository/CompletionRepository hand-rolls its own private copy instead of sharing one via E2EHarness (which already centralizes similar cross-cutting fixtures, e.g. dashboardSilenceOverrides) — at least 11 files repo-wide redefine _NullTutoredSelection verbatim, 4 of them in this batch. The copies have already diverged: learning_p0_test.dart's _FakeContentRepository.filterByLevel correctly filters by level1..4, while learning_p1_test.dart's same-named, same-interface fake silently ignores every level argument and returns the full unfiltered list. No test in learning_p1_test.dart currently drives level-filtered hierarchy browsing through this fake, so the bug is latent — but the next engineer who copies this file's pattern to add hierarchy coverage inherits a fake that compiles, matches the interface, and silently returns wrong results.
recommendation: Extract _NullTutoredSelection, _FakeContentRepository, and _FakeCompletionRepository into a shared test/e2e/fakes/ module (or onto E2EHarness) and delete the per-file copies; fix the shared filterByLevel to actually filter, matching learning_p0_test.dart's current correct behavior.
acceptance_criteria: A single _FakeContentRepository/_NullTutoredSelection implementation is imported by every e2e journey file that needs one (grep for 'class _NullTutoredSelection' returns one definition site).
The shared filterByLevel filters by level1..4 and is exercised by at least one test.
